units.source_text: 1. [\[17\]](../Text/chapter17.xhtml#fnref17) 吸量管一词在日语中的发音，与挥舞皮鞭发出的噼啪声相似。​

en.t: 1. Note 17: The Japanese pronunciation of the word for pipette resembles the cracking sound made when a whip is swung.

units.source_text: 2. [\[18\]](../Text/chapter17.xhtml#fnref18) 指先于父母去世的孩子，因未尽孝而受到苦难的地方。​

en.t: 2. Note 18: This refers to the place where children who die before their parents suffer because they were unable to fulfill their filial duty.
